summariesAndClaims.mockVlmSummaryText: In a section of seats above the right-field line at LoanDepot Park, a woman in a Phillies jersey reaches across two seats and takes a baseball out of the hands of a young boy holding it. The boy reacts visibly, raising his hands. A stadium employee approaches and hands the boy a second baseball a few seconds later.
